name: Precomputed Geometric Quantities for Contour Trees
definition: A method to efficiently precompute the geometric properties (area and volume) of all possible contours for each timestep in a 3D scalar field, allowing real-time evaluation of these properties for any selected isovalue without expensive surface extraction.
summary: Precomputed Geometric Quantities for Contour Trees enables real-time area and volume evaluation by hierarchically aggregating precomputed B-spline functions, avoiding expensive surface extraction.
